_comment: CIVILIAN kit: an ADVERT PANEL - a pale billboard carrying a cobalt roundel, two cobalt wordmark bars ragged like set type, and one small dark tagline. Commerce is the civilian voice: a warship stencils rounds counts and a scrapper paints kill marks, but a sold hull sells DECK SPACE. Paint-flat so it lies on any panel or straight edge, and long on Z so the run alignment reads it down the hull like livery on an airliner. Cobalt only - an advert is paint, and lit things on this kit are amber, which an advert is not.
